preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: MIX
  description: Due to the insolubility of most components, the required amount of
    each ingredient is added as powder to the final container, and then the necessary
    volume of water poured into it. Use a container with at least twice the volume
    capacity than medium. E.g. add 5 g of each soya flour, mannitol and agar to a
    500 ml Duran bottle and pour 250 ml of tap water.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: 'Use tap water, NOT deionised water. It is not necessary to be drinking
    water. Tip: adding very hot tap-water facilitates initial suspension and partial
    solution of components.'
- step_number: 3
  action: MIX
  description: The medium must be autoclaved twice. After the first round and while
    the medium is still quite hot (mind using heat-protection gloves) with the lid
    still slightly open swirl the bottle while allowing to release the pressure possibly
    remaining inside the bottle; close well the lid, and mix thoroughly by swirling
    the bottle; open the lid slightly (mind possible steam coming out) and autoclave
    again.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: 'Relevant references: Original recipe published in "Hobbs, Frazer,
    Gardner, Cullum, Oliver. “Dispersed Growth of Streptomyces in Liquid Culture.”
    Applied Microbiology and Biotechnology 31, no. 3 (September 1, 1989): 272–77.
    https://doi.org/10.1007/BF00258408". Most common recipe and that described here,
    published in "Kieser, Bibb, Buttner, Chater, Hopwood. Practical Streptomyces Genetics.
    Norwich: The John Innes Foundation, 2000." https://www.dsmz.de/research/publications/41184'

  Original URL: https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=1029

  Original JCM1029 is unavailable. Do not transfer DSMZ330's nominal denominator to this source. Split the 960 ml main water from the 1 L mineral-stock water; retain exact mg inputs and unquantified CO2. Provider preparation text: Adjust pH to 6.7 -- 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.
  Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium sulfide in distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while gassing with 100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave. Thereafter add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated sterile stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).

  Source: https://togomedium.org/medium/M1093

  Original URL: https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=1029

  Original JCM1029 is unavailable. Do not transfer DSMZ330's nominal denominator to this source. Split the 960 ml main water from the 1 L mineral-stock water; retain exact mg inputs and unquantified CO2. Provider preparation text: Adjust pH to 6.7 -- 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.
  Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium sulfide in distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while gassing with 100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave. Thereafter add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated sterile stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: MIX
  description: Prepare the printed single stocks in purified H2O or NNM and sterilize
    each stock by autoclaving or 0.22 um filtration as specified.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: Prepare the methyl-cellulose stock in cold H2O overnight before autoclaving;
    prepare the pectin stock in H2O with hot-plate stirring for 20 min before autoclaving.
- step_number: 3
  action: MIX
  description: Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 1 from the Si and Fe/EDTA stocks, fill with
    NNM, syringe-filter through 0.22 um, and store at 4 C.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 2 from the nitrate-phosphate stocks, fill
    with NNM, syringe-filter through 0.22 um, and prepare fresh each time.
- step_number: 5
  action: MIX
  description: Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 3 from the vitamin stocks, fill with NNM,
    syringe-filter through 0.22 um, and store at 4 C.
- step_number: 6
  action: MIX
  description: Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 4 from MEM 50X amino acids, MEM 100X amino
    acids, and the glutamine stock; fill with NNM, syringe-filter through 0.22 um,
    and store at 4 C.
- step_number: 7
  action: MIX
  description: Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 5 from glycerol and the carbon-source stocks,
    fill with NNM, vacuum-filter through 0.22 um, and store at 4 C.
- step_number: 8
  action: FILTER
  description: Combine 4 ml Mix solution 1, 30 ml Mix solution 2, 10.7 ml Mix solution
    3, 10.9 ml Mix solution 4, and 10.7 ml Mix solution 5; fill to 150 ml with NNM,
    vacuum-filter through 0.22 um, and store Nutrient Medium 1.0 at 4 C.
